positions.name: ZypherionDecisionRationale
positions.frame: what does the meeting record establish as the basis and shape of the Zypherion adoption decision?
positions.why: The spoken declaration and assertions (src-1..3) and the memo's bolded summary lines (src-4..6) both track the same three facets — tool choice, performance justification, timeline — read directionally as one decision record. The memo restates the spoken claims in a terser register; both readings hold together under one frame even though authorship/footing differs (spoken vs. memo-authored).
